title: AVRO-741. The avro_give* functions now all take in a custom free function that will be called once the datum no longer needs access to the underlying buffer.  This gives complete flexibility over wrapping external buffers into Avro datum instances.  The avro_wrap* functions have been removed, since this is now just a special case — just use NULL for the free function.  To get the previous behavior of avro_give* (where the buffer is freed using the custom allocator), use avro_alloc_free as the free function.
